Read the bsb nerdqaxe plus plus page

Neither listing publishes dimensions, Nicholas, so I won't guess at them. The S1 and the NerdQaxe++ are both small desk units, but the S1 is the bigger of the two, and they ship with different stands.

I've asked JD on our team for the measured size of each, bare without the stand, and he'll come back to you here or by email.

Fastest route if you want it now: our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post in the server and mention @nullhashrate (JD).
